remarks: Darien Beach rights and New Canaan Schools make this a very special offering! Storybook charm greets you at this one-of-a-kind, vintage Tudor home, set back from the road on landscaped property with lovely private terrace and lawns. Natural gas and town water and sewer are a definite plus for easy maintenance. A parcel of acreage is in Darien, offering the unique option of full access to beaches and boat launch. Timbered beam construction is authentic to the original structure and creates a fairytale ambiance throughout. Thoughtful updates provide the comforts of today's living without sacrificing the essence of a Tudor style including wide plank hardwood floors and original hardware. The great room with vaulted ceiling, stone hearth and wraparound balcony is the captivating focal point w/open access to family and dining rooms and the delightful porch off the terrace. An office and four en-suite bedrooms, including one on the main floor and one with walk out access to a large deck over the garage allows for versatile options. Manicured lawns and gardens surround the bluestone terrace for gracious entertaining and cul de sac access from the side lawn is perfect for bike riding or pet walking. Minutes to New Canaan schools and village, Talmadge Hill train and Pkwy, as well as a short drive to the beaches in Darien.  A truly wonderful location!
